tei:div.tei:p: gnas brtan phyag mchod ni/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gzhal med gru bzhi pa// padma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skem shing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa'i// phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal// yon sbyor mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan chen po bzhugs so 'tshal// dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra dhwa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len// lam bstan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*// khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong ba'i// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa srung*// rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du// gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po// dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshigs nyan pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// mtshungs med blta bas mi ngoms shing*// gser gyi mdog can mdzes pa'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// gangs ri chen po ti se la// 'phags pa gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*// dgra bcom stong dang sum brgyas bskor// spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// drang srong ri yi shel ngos na// 'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa// dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe=

bstan pa rgyas= lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na// 'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas// dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor// sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= gnas mchog dam pa zangs gling na// 'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni// dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor// gser gyi rna bsgor 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= siṅga la yi gling na ni// gnas brtan rdo rje mo'u bu// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= chu bo ya mu na'i gling na// 'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni// dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor// chos 'chad mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= gnas mchog dam pa kha che na// 'phags pa gnas brtan gser be'u// dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyas bskor// rin chen zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= nub kyi ba glang spyod na ni// bha ra dhwa dza gser can mchog /dgra bcom chen po bdun brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni// 'phags pa gnas brtan ba ku la// dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis ne'u le 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= pri yang ku yi gling na ni// 'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin// dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor// rin chen prog zhu 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la// 'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran bstan// dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= shar gyi lus 'phags gling na ni// bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// glegs bam lhung bzed 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe=

bstan pa rgyas= lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na// 'phags pa gnas brtan lam bstan ni// dgra bcom stong dang dgu brgyas bskor// glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad phyag 'tshal| /bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs la// 'phags pa'i gnas brtan klu yi sde// dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor// bum pa mkhar gsil 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= ri yi rgyal po bi hu lar// 'phags pa gnas brtan sbed byed ni// dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= ri yi rgyal po gangs can la// 'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// byang chen mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharma ta// ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khur// snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs// rnga yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bla ma'i sku tshe= bstan pa rgyas= brtson pa'i go bgos mthu stobs can// sangs rgyas bstan pa legs skyong ba// shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i= bstan pa= 'phags pa'i gang zag khyed rnams la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig pa bshags// yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// dbang bcu mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang*// sbyin bdag bar chad zhi ba dang*// sems can sdig pa sbyong du gsol// sangs rgyas sprul pa 'phags pa'i tshogs// bstan pa skyong ba'i las mdzad pa// gnas brtan chen po 'khor bcas kyi// bstan pa yun ring gnas gyur cig /srid las rnam grol nyon mongs med// zad dang skye ba mi shes pa// khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya yi// bstan pa yun ring gnas gyur cig /byang sems nyan thos chen po'i tshul// bstan skyong 'gro don rgyun mi chad// dge legs yon tan rnam 'phel ba// gnas brtan chen po'i bkra shis shog

/zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bsngo ba smon lam 'grub par shog /kha che pan chen shākya shrīs mdzad par grags so/// /
